Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server—new US government regions

Body.Content:
With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server to the US Gov Virginia and US Gov Arizona regions, you can now: 

  • Optimize lower total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKU 
  • Access the stop/start feature
  • Experience better resiliency with zone redundant high availability (currently available only in US Gov Virginia region)
  • Increase control with scheduled maintenance 
  • Utilize enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption 
  • Experience the openness of the Postgres database community version 

Review the Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server documentation and availability by region to learn more.
